name: waypoint-dispatch
description: Waypoint Dispatch — monorepo root used by Vercel build pipeline.

scripts.postinstall: node -e "const fs=require('fs'); if(fs.existsSync('server/prisma/schema.prisma')) { try { require('child_process').execSync('npx prisma generate --schema=server/prisma/schema.prisma', {stdio:'inherit'}); } catch (e) { console.log('Prisma generate notice:', e.message); } }"
scripts.build: node -e "const fs=require('fs'); if(fs.existsSync('server/prisma/schema.prisma')) { try { require('child_process').execSync('npx prisma generate --schema=server/prisma/schema.prisma', {stdio:'inherit'}); } catch (e) { console.log('Prisma generate notice:', e.message); } }"
scripts.vercel-build: node -e "const fs=require('fs'); if(fs.existsSync('server/prisma/schema.prisma')) { try { require('child_process').execSync('npx prisma generate --schema=server/prisma/schema.prisma', {stdio:'inherit'}); } catch (e) { console.log('Prisma generate notice:', e.message); } }"
